# at narrative position

Anchors a thing — a content segment, a diegetic event, an arc sample, a motif occurrence — to a narrative position. Domain-free: the narration seam (#360), arc samples (#361), and motif occurrences (#363) all reuse this one anchor. NOT functional, and deliberately so: the same diegetic event carries coexisting positions in a discourse frame and a story frame, and their disagreement is the flashback made queryable rather than a contradiction (Principle 9).

**IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/atNarrativePosition>  
**CURIE:** `gmeow:atNarrativePosition`
